targets.coverage: Noether Paper 19, Idealtheorie in Ringbereichen, tail slice printed pp.58-66, focusing on sections 10-12 and the final element-divisor proof. The package reports one high-severity source-confirmed mathematical index error in the element-divisor proof: C/D exponent systems should use s_1...s_lambda and t_1...t_mu, with r_nu=s_1<=s_2<=...<=s_lambda<=r_nu, not s_nu...s_i/t_nu...t_i. It also reports one low-severity source-order cleanup for the congruence pair after Wegen. Both fixes were applied locally, and the patched cumulative TeX copy is included under applied_fixed_tex. Checked no-fix anchors are included for pp.59-66.
